subject: Vendor portal profile curation & evidence ramp-down — FinEdge
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.infra>
To: Julia Hart <julia.hart@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.infra>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.infra>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor portal profile curation & evidence ramp-down — FinEdge

Hi Julia —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. To keep this narrow and reduce churn for your reviewers, we'd like to propose a short ramp-down window for the FinEdge Vendr profile:

- Scope: remove stale temp-credentials proof attachments, consolidate KMS proof pointers, and trim older CAIQ fragments that are superseded by the SOC2 package.
- Timeline: small maintenance window Tuesday 2026-09-14 09:00-11:00 PT (low-impact).
- Deliverables from your side: confirmation of the three documents below (or pointers to updated versions):
  1) SOC2 artifact bundle (link or manifest)
  2) KMS key rotation proof (IAM policy + rotation record)
  3) Network segmentation diagram for API egress (PDF)

We'll upload an S3 manifest and an updated SIG->CAIQ mapping sheet to Vendr before the window and move deprecated artifacts to an archival folder during the window. Attaching the manifest template and our proposed mapping.

Attachments: s3-evidence-manifest.csv (template), sig-mapping.xlsx (proposed)

Ask: can you confirm access for the Vendr service account (svc-vendr@finedge.com) and whether the SOC2 bundle should be staged in your secure folder or attached directly to the profile?

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Sr. Security Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.infra

From: Julia Hart <julia.hart@finedge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.infra>
Date: 2026-09-07T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal profile curation & evidence ramp-down — FinEdge

Mina —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications before we lock the window:

1) svc-vendr@finedge.com currently has read-only access to our Vendr tenant. We can elevate to upload privileges but need a short procurement ticket. Is the upload a one-time push or do you expect repeated pushes?
2) SOC2 bundle — we'd prefer it staged in our secure folder (Finance/Contracts) with a pointer in the Vendr profile. Security will not accept attachments on the profile for PII-containing artifacts.
3) The network diagram should be the latest version (v3.1). I can attach that once I confirm with infra.

Also tagging security@finedge.com for the KMS rotation proof question.

On the timeline, 9/14 looks fine if we have upload permissions by 9/13 EOD.

Thanks —
Julia
Head of Vendor Ops
FinEdge

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.infra>
To: Julia Hart <julia.hart@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.infra>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.infra>
Date: 2026-09-07T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal profile curation & evidence ramp-down — FinEdge

Julia —

Thanks, that works. Quick answers:

- Upload cadence: this is intended as a single coordinated maintenance push + a follow-up verification pass. If you prefer to keep staging in your secure folder, we'll reference the SharePoint pointer in the Vendr profile and skip attaching anything that contains PII.
- We'll open procurement ticket details on our side to request svc-vendr upload privileges; can you confirm the internal ticket number once raised so Karthik can follow?
- We'll treat the KMS rotation proof as a pointer (key id + signed rotation log) rather than an embedded file.

Next steps (for the 9/14 window):
1) FinEdge: stage SOC2 bundle in Finance/Contracts and confirm Svc account upload perms by 2026-09-13 17:00 PT.
2) Redwood: prepare S3 manifest and SIG->CAIQ mapping; we'll post links to the Vendr profile prior to the window.
3) Joint verification meeting 2026-09-14 11:30 PT (optional) to confirm artifacts are discoverable.

I'll attach the manifest & mapping to the Vendr task and flag any fields we will not touch (to avoid accidental deletion).

— Mina

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.infra>
To: Julia Hart <julia.hart@finedge.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.infra>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.infra>
Date: 2026-09-09T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal profile curation & evidence ramp-down — FinEdge

Julia —

Following up after Mina's note: procurement ticket received this morning (FT-4521) — thanks for the quick turn. We've updated the S3 manifest with the expected destination paths and uploaded the two files to our staging bucket:

- s3://redwood-onboarding/finedge/2026-09-14/s3-evidence-manifest.csv
- s3://redwood-onboarding/finedge/2026-09-14/sig-mapping.xlsx

We will not attach SOC2 artifacts directly to Vendr; instead we'll add the SharePoint URL and the manifest pointer. During the maintenance window we'll move outdated temp-cred attachments into an archival folder and flag any CAIQ fragments that should be trimmed.

If security@finedge.com wants any additional hashes or signed attestations for the files, reply-all and we will produce SHA256 checksums.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Product Security — Integrations
Redwood Inference
